summary: Code-review verification of INV-1 Supporting Records second-PDF upload (web + mobile) and tabbed logged-out/mobile marketing sample. All reference files reviewed line-by-line against the spec. Backend accepts optional supporting_file multipart field, passes parsed snapshot into run_checks and surfaces reconciliation.supporting_records metadata; single-file path unchanged (Optional[UploadFile] = File(None)). Web InvoiceSampleResult is correctly gated to the ToolGate 'blocked' branch (logged-out); has data-testid invoice-sample-output, invoice-sample-tabs, invoice-sample-tab-overcharge (DEFAULT via useState), invoice-sample-tab-clean, invoice-sample-body-overcharge/clean, with the exact spec numbers (overcharge: billed 1019.06, refund 466.66, 31 lines, 11 findings; clean: 495.41/0.00/7 lines/1 info). Web authenticated upload appends supporting_file to FormData only when the user attaches a second file; inv1-supporting-block appears only after a primary file is chosen. Mobile InvoiceChecker renders InvoiceSampleResult on idle (!file && !result && !guard && !dupe) matching web parity, same testIDs, same default overcharge tab, same fixture numbers. Mobile two-file upload uses a new uploadMultipart helper in src/lib/api.ts that reads file:// URIs into blobs via expo/fetch and posts a single multipart body with both 'file' and 'supporting_file' fields; falls back to the existing single-file uploadFile path when no supporting file is attached. NO browser automation was executed this iteration due to token budget; verification is static code-review only. Backend engine numbers were already locked by /app/backend/tests/inv1/test_samburke_inv2_fixture.py (12/12 passing) so no retest of the engine was required.
action_items: Main agent self-smoke: (1) logged-out WEB visit /ai-tools/invoice-checker → verify invoice-sample-tab-overcharge default, flip to clean; (2) WEB authenticated upload invoice + supporting_file as cathy@example.com and confirm reconciliation.supporting_records present; (3) MOBILE idle state at /tool/invoice-checker shows tabbed sample, same two files upload path via uploadMultipart.
critical_code_review_comments: Web InvoiceSampleResult.jsx (336 lines) is a single large static-data file. Consider extracting the two fixture objects to /app/frontend/src/components/samples/invoice-fixtures.js so the mobile and web stay DRY — currently CLEAN_RESULT/OVERCHARGE_RESULT are duplicated across web .jsx and mobile .tsx (minor; copies are intentional per spec, but a shared JSON file would prevent future drift between surfaces).

Backend invoices.py is 1372 lines — above the 700-line guideline. Not a blocker for this change, but splitting letter-draft helpers, vault save, and overcharge-alerts into submodules would improve maintainability.

uploadMultipart in mobile/src/lib/api.ts correctly uses expo/fetch for file:// URIs on native + web, mirrors uploadFile's auth-refresh + ApiError pattern, and is isolated to the two-file path. Good design.
